The '''shaman mask''' is a rare drop from [[Ogress Warrior]]s and [[Ogress Shaman|Shamans]] in the [[Corsair Cove Dungeon]]. It has similar defensive stats to an [[iron full helm]] and is tied with the [[wizard hat]] as well as [[blue wizard hat]] for the highest magic attack bonus in [[free-to-play]].
